text:
Samira Gomez: Hi team — quick question. We just finalized adoption of a toddler, and the court date is July 2. I plan to start parental leave July 1 for 6 weeks. Also wondering about the adoption stipend, travel reimbursement, and whether I can bring the kiddo to the office for the first week as part of transition.

Michelle (People Ops): Huge congrats Samira! :tada: Adoption leave is the same process — file in HR portal selecting "Parental leave - adoption" and attach the court notice. For stipend: Redwood offers an adoption reimbursement up to $5k; submit receipts in Expensify under "Adoption Reimbursement" within 90 days.

Sam (People Ops): For travel reimbursement: if you incur airfare/lodging related to the adoption placement, those are eligible under the adoption stipend. Keep itemized receipts. We can advance funds if you need cashflow; request via the Payroll Advance form and copy me.

Samira Gomez: Great. Can I bring the child to the office the first week to ease transitions (short visits during the day)? Not sure about security badge rules.

Ellen Park: For security and liability we need a temporary visitor badge. Submit a Visitor Request form to Facilities with the date range and emergency contact. Facilities will run a quick background check for guests aged 18+; younger children are fine but must be accompanied. Also check with your manager about noise-sensitive meetings.

benefits-bot: Quick policy notes: Adoption leave eligibility: all full-time employees with >3 months tenure. Paid leave: up to 12 weeks (varies by tenure). Adoption stipend: up to $5,000, receipts required. Travel advance available. Link: https://handbook.internal/benefits/adoption

Samira Gomez: One more HR/process question: I have a performance calibration in mid-July. Will leave affect promotion/bonus cycle?

Michelle (People Ops): You can request a defer in the review form. Option A: defer calibration until return; Option B: manager performs limited check-in but pauses compensation/promotion decisions. If you want parity, choose defer and HR will annotate calibration docs.

Samira Gomez: I	ll pick defer. Also can you confirm whether I need to return my laptop before leave? I may need it for calls with placement agency in the first week.

Sam (People Ops): You can retain the device during adoption leave. Submit an IT retention request and copy People Ops. If you need a temporary caregiver hotspot, IT can provide one for up to 30 days.

Michelle (People Ops): Timeline recap:
- By June 10: upload court notice and submit HR leave request
- By June 15: submit adoption stipend receipts or request advance if needed
- July 1: leave start (6 weeks) with Facilities visitor badge for short on-site visits
- Mid-July: review deferred per request

Samira Gomez: Thanks all 

Sam (People Ops): Sending DM with the forms and the advance template now.

Ellen Park: Facilities will process the visitor badge once form is submitted. Reach out if you need same-day processing.

Samira Gomez: Appreciate it. Really helps to have the logistics sorted :)
